title: 新式随机数 API：default_rng 与 Generator
expected_output:
values = [ 0.304717 -1.039984  0.750451  0.940565]
reproducible = True
integers = [2 0 5 9 7]
is Generator = True
code:
import numpy as np
rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
v1 = rng.standard_normal(4)
rng2 = np.random.default_rng(42)
v2 = rng2.standard_normal(4)
print("values =", np.round(v1, 6))
print("reproducible =", np.array_equal(v1, v2))
print("integers =", rng.integers(0, 10, size=5))
print("is Generator =", isinstance(rng, np.random.Generator))
